base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user find and settle into a new apartment rental. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I'm looking for a new apartment to rent. I've narrowed it down to 3 places.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 apartments: Apartment A in Chaoyang district, Apartment B in Tongzhou district, Apartment C in Changping district

Apartment A: Chaoyang, 2-bedroom, 7500 yuan/month, 20 min subway to work. Apartment B: Tongzhou, 2-bedroom, 3800 yuan/month, 1 hour 40 min commute. Apartment C: Changping, 1-bedroom, 2800 yuan/month, 45 min subway to work.
Apartment A commute: 20 min door-to-door. Apartment B commute: 1 hour 40 min including a bus transfer. Apartment C commute: 45 min direct subway line.

constraints.value: Maximum rent budget is 3000 yuan per month (9000 salary, rent must not exceed one-third of income = 3000)
constraints.surface_form: My monthly salary is 9000 yuan. My dad always drilled into me that rent should never be more than a third of your income, and I think that's smart — especially since I'm trying to save up
inference_chain: Rent should not exceed one-third of income

constraints.value: Commute must be under 1 hour one way
constraints.surface_form: I really don't want to spend more than an hour commuting each way — I had that before and it burned me out completely

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 apartments (A in Chaoyang, B in Tongzhou, C in Changping). You will share apartment details, your salary, your spending rule, and your commute preference across several turns. Friends will talk positively about Chaoyang and Tongzhou. At the very end, you will say you have decided and ask what monthly expenses will look like — you must NEVER name which apartment you picked, let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact person. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You never express frustration or impatience. Each update is shared as normal coordination.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could cause identity confusion or answer leakage

aims.description: I'm looking for a new apartment to rent. I've narrowed it down to 3 places — one in Chaoyang, one in Tongzhou, and one in Changping.

So Apartment A in Chaoyang is a 2-bedroom, 7500 a month, about 20 minutes to my office by subway. Apartment B in Tongzhou is also a 2-bedroom, 3800 a month, but the commute is like an hour forty with a bus transfer. Apartment C in Changping is a 1-bedroom, 2800 a month, 45 minutes on a direct subway line.
aims.success_criteria: Agent processes all 3 apartments with prices and commute times
aims.conversation_goal: Burst delivery: 3 options with price and commute attributes in ONE turn

aims.description: My friend just moved to Chaoyang last month. She keeps posting about how many great restaurants and cafes are within walking distance — looks like an amazing neighborhood for going out.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to positive Chaoyang neighborhood description

drift_config.drift_topic: just moved to Chaoyang, lots of restaurants and cafes nearby, great neighborhood vibe

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 1: create positive recency bias toward Apartment A (Chaoyang)

aims.description: My monthly salary is 9000 yuan. My dad always drilled into me that rent should never be more than a third of your income, and I think that's smart — especially since I'm trying to save up.
aims.success_criteria: Agent registers the income and spending rule, ideally computing 9000/3 = 3000 max rent
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver budget constraint via income + rule — eliminates A (7500) and B (3800)

aims.description: My friend in Chaoyang also mentioned her building has a rooftop garden and a shared gym — she said it makes coming home feel like a mini vacation.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to more positive Chaoyang amenities

drift_config.drift_topic: Chaoyang apartment has rooftop garden and shared gym, feels like a mini vacation

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 2: more positive info about Apartment A (already eliminated by budget)

aims.description: I really don't want to spend more than an hour commuting each way — I had that before and it burned me out completely.
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes this eliminates Apartment B (1 hour 40 min commute)
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver commute constraint — eliminates B (1h40m > 1h limit)

aims.description: My colleague lives in Tongzhou and he's been raving about the new shopping mall that opened near his place — apparently it has a huge cinema complex and tons of food options.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to positive Tongzhou neighborhood update

drift_config.drift_topic: lives in Tongzhou, new shopping mall with cinema and food options opened nearby

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 3: create positive recency bias toward Apartment B (Tongzhou)

aims.description: My colleague also said his Tongzhou apartment is way more spacious than anything you'd find closer to the city center — he's got a full home office setup and still has a guest room.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to positive Tongzhou space/value comment

drift_config.drift_topic: Tongzhou apartment much more spacious, has home office and guest room, great value

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 4: more positive info about Apartment B (eliminated by both budget and commute)

aims.description: Alright I've made my decision. Help me figure out what my total monthly expenses will look like once I move in — rent, utilities, transport, groceries, the whole picture.
aims.success_criteria: Agent bases the monthly expense breakdown on Apartment C (2800 rent in Changping, 45 min subway commute) as the only option within the 3000 budget cap and under 1 hour commute
aims.conversation_goal: Forward-pushing probe: user says they decided, asks for expense breakdown — agent must determine it is Apartment C and use 2800 rent

ground_truth.answer: The user should move into Apartment C (Changping, 1-bedroom, 2800 yuan/month, 45 min subway commute). Apartment A (7500) and Apartment B (3800) both exceed the computed 3000 budget cap (9000 salary ÷ 3 = 3000). Apartment B also violates the commute constraint (1 hour 40 min > 1 hour max). Only Apartment C (2800 < 3000, 45 min < 1 hour) satisfies both constraints.
required_elements: Agent shows that the rent budget cap is 3000 yuan by computing 9000 divided by 3 equals 3000
Agent shows that Apartment A at 7500 yuan exceeds the derived 3000 budget cap from 9000 salary divided by 3
Agent shows that Apartment B at 3800 yuan exceeds the derived 3000 budget cap, and additionally that its 1 hour 40 minute commute exceeds the 1 hour maximum
Agent bases the monthly expense breakdown on Apartment C with 2800 yuan rent as the chosen apartment
Agent uses the 45 minute direct subway commute from Apartment C when estimating transport costs
forbidden_elements: Calculating expenses based on Apartment A rent of 7500 (exceeds 3000 budget cap by 150%)
Calculating expenses based on Apartment B rent of 3800 (exceeds 3000 budget cap and commute is 1 hour 40 min)
Asking the user which apartment they decided on (should be determinable from constraints)
Ignoring the one-third income rule when determining which apartment was chosen
Suggesting the user could stretch to afford Apartment A or B
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: salary 9000, one-third rule means max rent = 3000. A=7500 (150% over cap), B=3800 (27% over cap), C=2800 (within cap). Commute constraint: max 1 hour. A=20min (OK), B=1h40m (violates), C=45min (OK). Only C passes both constraints. Despite 4 drift turns praising Chaoyang (A) and Tongzhou (B) neighborhoods, the agent must respect the hard constraints and base the expense breakdown on Apartment C at 2800 rent.

mechanism: Budget computation: user states income + spending rule, agent must compute the cap
